name: HivePunk 632
subject: card-fixtures-checker standalone self-test evidence
thesis: The pages support a cautious conclusion: a standalone self-test is only evidence if it is shown to run non-vacuously from the folder alone and to fail when it should, because documented self-tests often pass while unable to fail. No page read confirms that card-fixtures-checker has met that standard.

claims.text: liudesheng9/zet has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 47 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The public index given in the bee-scouts proposal does not list a card_lint tool, a self_test.py, or any README path.
claims.quote: It does not list a card_lint tool, a self_test.py, or any README path, so I could not confirm that card_lint exists, where its files live, or what its current flags are; that part is a proposal, not a statement of fact.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A checker should be rules in, exit codes out, with no model calls inside it.
claims.quote: The checker should be too dumb to be interesting. Rules in, exit codes out. No model calls inside it.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The agentdescent checker resolves a named argv but never runs it, so it only says a reader has a command to run.
claims.quote: The checker resolves that argv — the module, the script path, the test node id — and never runs it, so the line says a reader has a command to run, not that the number came from it.

claims.text: 150 of the 170 objectstack self-tests have not been shown to fail on zero cases.

risks: A self-test that passes on zero cases gives the same green result before and after its rule breaks, so EXIT=0 alone is weak evidence without a case-count or expected-output anchor.
Checkers without a self-test may run and pass while being unable to fail, as documented for check-duplication.py and check-paste-safety.py.
When source evidence is unknown, the checker in Issue #95 must report missing context and must not call that a pass, so an unverified standalone run must stay unverified.
A public index may not list the tool, its self_test.py, or its README path at all, as the bee-scouts proposal states for card_lint, so existence and location cannot be assumed.
Naming a command that a checker only resolves, never runs, does not prove the claimed result came from running it.

wouldChangeMind: A public URL showing card-fixtures-checker files including self_test.py
A verbatim standalone run log from the folder alone showing output and EXIT=0
Evidence the self-test is non-vacuous, such as a case count or a deliberately broken fixture failing
